title: Payment settlement callbacks require webhook trust and supplier governance
project_brief: An accounting service relies on a third-party payment processor for settlement events.
request: Receive HTTPS callbacks from the payment processor when settlements are created or reversed, update invoice state from those events, and handle retries safely. The processor is an external vendor and its callback authenticity and delivery contract must be treated as trust boundaries.

must_not_claim: the provider sending HTTPS is sufficient authenticity evidence
